events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Marking 30 years since the tragic death of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: Three decades since Tupac Shakur's untimely passing. His music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Guitar Legend Remembered
events.blurb: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix on the anniversary of his death.

angles.name: Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Still mesmerised by the genius of Jimi Hendrix. His sound changed everything. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released 57 years ago today.

angles.name: Timeless Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks – pure magic.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the formidable Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still got that swagger. What's your favourite Oasis tune with his iconic vocals?

events.title: 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today.

angles.name: A Song for the World
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' gave us a message of peace and unity that still resonates. Timeless.

events.title: The iPod: 25 Years Since Launch
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago it changed the game for music lovers everywhere. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Six decades since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: A True Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music still inspires.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a master of British comedy.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled 'White Album' was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: A Double Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles released 'The White Album'. So much creativity packed into one record. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul' album was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: A Pivotal Moment
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped and changed the game. A true masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon 46 years after his tragic death.

angles.name: Forever Missed
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.
